plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for ADVA / ADTRAN optical transmission device. It reports uptime, memory total/free/used/utilization, and interface traffic, for FSP 150 / FSP 3000 network elements (enterprise PEN 2544).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total memory of the ADVA network element (neMemorySizeTotal). The device reports kBytes; the value is scaled to bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports the free memory of the ADVA network element (neMemorySizeFree). The device reports kBytes; the value is scaled to bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the used memory of the ADVA network element, calculated as total minus free (neMemorySizeTotal - neMemorySizeFree) and scaled from kBytes to bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the memory utilization of the ADVA network element, calculated as (total - free) / total. Sustained high memory usage may indicate control-plane resource pressure or unstable device services.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counters.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counters.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the Ciena CES/SAOS transmission device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
